method: the same population, producer index and path classification as E395, with its substring face matcher replaced by a path-segment matcher; the A/B is produced by re-running E395's measure() with the matcher patched, never by editing its published rows
refusals: a basename collision is published as exposure, not as a proven misread of a published number that was not re-derived here
basename_only is its own class: a call that names the right filename in the wrong directory cannot confirm the face and is not evidence of another document
unresolved is not another_file: the path may be assembled from variables
the history probe is capped at 40 revisions and the cap is published
the study excludes its own source, face, mirror and smoke leg
a key that is absent from every inspected revision is reported as absent, not as a schema regression

each arm of the A/B runs in its own interpreter: the corpus holds an 8.9 MB generated source, and running both arms in one process made the second arm die in ast.parse with MemoryError, which is a property of the runner and not of the matcher being compared
verify_covers: A/B pair counts re-added from the two verdict tables
every moved pair re-derived from the two published verdict strings
the census pair count re-added from the published sample plus its own total
verify_does_not_cover: the AST re-parse of each producer (verify reads the published tables)
whether any other published study consumed a face by basename
